shadows.name: board
shadows.purpose: SVG board filter: drop-shadow; no card elevation.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Implemented action style, including hover, focus and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 16px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d6d7c9); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; background: var(--accent, #a3442d); border-color: var(--accent, #a3442d); color: var(--surface, #fffcf5); font-weight: 700; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #873722); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a3442d); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Implemented action style, including hover, focus and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font: 16px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d6d7c9); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #243c32); } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--button-hover, #e5e9dc); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a3442d); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text button
components.description: Implemented action style, including hover, focus and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-text { font: 16px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d6d7c9); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; background: transparent; color: var(--accent, #a3442d); min-height: 32px; padding: 2px 0; border: 0; font-size: 13px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text:hover { background: var(--button-hover, #e5e9dc); } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a3442d); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Cream field with a clear keyboard outline.
components.css: .ds-input { font: 16px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; background: var(--surface, #fffcf5); color: var(--ink, #243c32); border: 1px solid #8b9989; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 42px; caret-color: var(--accent, #a3442d); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #5b685d); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a3442d); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary navigation
components.description: Compact destinations with a filled active state.
components.html: PlayTrainingSettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; font: 14px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--muted, #5b685d); padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #e9ebdf; } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { background: var(--ink, #243c32); color: var(--surface, #fffcf5); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #a3442d); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { font: 600 9px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d6d7c9); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--muted, #5b685d); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Bot card
components.description: Flat cream container used in Training.
components.css: .ds-card { font: 16px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #243c32); background: var(--surface, #fffcf5); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d6d7c9); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; min-width: 0; } .ds-card h3 { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.035em; margin: 22px 0 10px; } .ds-card p { color: var(--muted, #5b685d); font-size: 13px; min-height: 40px; }

components.name: Play panel
components.description: Soft sage container beside the board.
components.css: .ds-panel { font: 16px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #243c32); background: #e8ecdf; border-radius: 10px; padding: 30px 24px 24px; } .ds-panel h2 { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.035em; margin: 0 0 30px; } .ds-panel h3 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.035em; margin: 6px 0 2px; } .ds-panel p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #5b685d); }

narrative.overview:
A warm, calm light shell surrounds a contrasting dark green long-nardy board. The board carries the visual weight; compact navigation, quiet dividers and a restrained terracotta action color keep the next move clear.

Training uses the same palette and typography with denser forms and real model data. The interface is desktop-first and stacks into a single column on small screens.
keyCharacteristics: Board-led play with a compact action sidebar.
Warm paper surfaces, forest green ink and terracotta actions.
Quiet containers, readable forms and visible keyboard focus.
dos: Do keep the board dominant and the next game action easy to find.
Do use real saved boards, opponents and training results.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and wrapping for long identifiers.
Do preserve dense working forms in Training.
donts: Don't add decorative eyebrows above page titles.
Don't use fabricated difficulty labels or training metrics.
Don't let the page overflow horizontally on mobile; wide research tables scroll inside their container.
